name: Friday Night Funkin' D-Sides Redux
summary:
Acclaimed mod "D-Sides" is back after 3 years with a fresh new coat of paint. Face off against iconic Friday Night Funkin' characters with a unique twist, alongside some other friends...

You play as Boyfriend, trying to prove your worth to your Girlfriend's family with your one (useful) talent -- rapping. Think you got what it takes to get freaky on a Friday night? ;)
